Collibra is the Enterprise AI Control Plane. Built over eighteen years of meta-data and ontology engineering, Collibra governs context and control across any data storage system, AI model, and AI agent. Collibra delivers clarity and context to AI leaders who need data certainty at the speed of AI. A 5x Forrester Wave Leader and 2x Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, Collibra serves more than 700 customers, including 78 of the Fortune 500, and governs more than 2 billion assets.

Collibra Public Sector LLC is the purpose-built subsidiary that serves US federal government agencies and the Defense Industrial Base. Collibra Public Sector is a FOCI-mitigated entity with a DCSA facility clearance. Collibra Public Sector personnel service clients in some of the most demanding mission organizations. Collibra Public Sector products, people and partners are uniquely positioned to deliver software and services solutions to the US federal market.

Join Collibra Public Sector

Collibra is looking for a proven General Manager to create and execute the overall business strategy to achieve long-term profitable growth that outpaces competitors and peers. Responsibilities include recruiting and leading a high-performing team that integrates sales, consulting services, support, legal, operations, marketing, product management, and product delivery. The General Manager will set the direction for the subsidiary to comply with government-required mandates such as CMMC. The General Manager will identify untapped market areas and build plans to capture those opportunities.

Successful outcomes

  • Operate as a true GM leading sales, services, support that aligns parent-company dependencies into a single, accountable operating rhythm
  • Optimize post-sales execution by driving consistent deployments, adoption, and renewal readiness across Public Sector accounts
  • Manage overall expense to revenue targets
  • Spend the company’s money wisely to invest in new opportunities
  • Work closely with the parent to drive the overall Public Sector product roadmap and align any support needed from the shared services teams
  • Maintain positive evaluations from relevant government agencies such as DCSA

Characteristics

  • Demonstrated ability to manage directly and delegate effectively across all areas of responsibilities
  • Create a culture of trust and accountability within Collibra Public Sector
  • Know when to build consensus and when to maintain autonomy
  • Bold risk-taking based on deep understanding of complex data
  • Politically astute when dealing with diverse stakeholders and conflicting demands

Experience

  • Experience managing a complete public sector subsidiary within a larger organization
  • Extended positions with increasing levels of responsibilities within enterprise software companies
  • Successful execution of business transformations and realignments
  • Bachelor’s degree required, MBA preferred

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits.

We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Sr. Director, Enablement to join our Revenue team. This position will report to the VP, Revenue Operations and Enablement. The Revenue Operations and Enablement team is responsible for sales strategy, technology, and enablement. The Sr. Director, Enablement will build a repeatable enablement framework to systematically support all segments of LaunchDarkly’s Revenue Organization. This role will ensure that all customer-facing personnel have the knowledge, content, skills, processes, and behaviors needed to optimize every interaction with buyers. The role will also oversee the planning and execution of Revenue Organization events, including SKOs.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with leadership experience in a revenue-focused organization where enablement is integrated into every interaction. They bring deep experience developing enablement programs, supporting ongoing employee development, and implementing the processes and tools required to build a world-class enablement function.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the multi-year revenue enablement strategy and roadmap, aligned to GTM priorities, with quarterly outcomes tied to ramp time, win rate, and quota attainment.
  • Lead and grow a global team of enablement leaders and specialists, setting clear priorities, coaching for excellence, and operating as a player-coach where needed.
  • Architect role-based onboarding and continuous readiness for all revenue roles (Sales, Sales Managers, SEs, CS, BDR/SDR, PAMs), covering product, process, messaging, and selling skills, including pitch certification, with ramp metrics tracked from day one.
  • Equip teams to win with technical buyers by developing playbooks, talk tracks, objection handling, and competitive messaging for developer, platform engineering, DevOps, and engineering leadership personas, and by owning the sales playbook for Land & Expand motions, including New Logo and Expansion plays.
  • Own the enablement track for the annual GTM kickoff and quarterly business reviews, with full oversight of content and readiness.
  • Modernize the enablement tech stack (LMS, CMS, sales engagement, conversation intelligence) and embed AI into seller workflows to accelerate productivity, coaching, and deal execution, while maintaining a company-wide content map that serves as a single source of truth for the field.
  • Partner with the CRO, VP Sales, VP CS, Product, Product Marketing, and Partner leaders to align messaging, qualification frameworks, and customer journey execution, and advise GTM leadership on readiness and change management for new initiatives.
  • Build dashboards and reporting that link enablement to GTM outcomes (rep, PAM, and SDR productivity, internal satisfaction, completion), using data to prioritize investment and retire programs that don't move the number.
  • Define and drive the partner enablement strategy, aligned with internal enablement programs and GTM motions.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years combined in sales and sales enablement at enterprise SaaS companies, including 5+ years in leadership.
  • Track record of scaling onboarding and enablement in a high-growth environment.
  • Deep expertise in core enablement disciplines: value selling, sales process and methodologies, coaching, skill development, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to partner across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and Product to build a culture of alignment.
  • History of designing and launching partner enablement programs.
  • Skilled at creating learning content and shaping a unified communications strategy that keeps the field informed and aligned.
  • Prior work in a GTM strategy role, with a strong grasp of how enablement connects to revenue planning.
  • Success planning and executing large-scale events, such as global sales kickoffs.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence at every level, including executive leadership.
  • Nice to have:
    • Time spent carrying a quota in a selling role.
    • Leadership of a sales-related function, such as Sales Development, Inside Sales, or Enterprise Sales.
    • Familiarity with enterprise technology companies serving the developer space.
    • Hands-on work developing competitive programs, buyer personas, and customer reference programs.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level M5:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $240,600 - $330,700**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $216,500 - $297,600*
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $204,500 - $281,100**
  • All Zones Inclusive of 20% Bonus Target

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com.

Do you need a disability accommodation?

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @LaunchDarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to careers@launchdarkly.com.

Ajax Systems ist ein internationales Technologieunternehmen und der größte Hersteller von Sicherheitssystemen in Europa mit über 4,5 Millionen Endnutzern und 330.000 PRO-Nutzern in mehr als 180 Ländern weltweit. Das Unternehmen bietet End-to-End-Lösungen zum Schutz von Wohn- und Geschäftsobjekten jeder Größenordnung. Bis heute umfasst das Produktportfolio von Ajax 280 Geräte für Einbruchschutz, Videoüberwachung, Brand- und Lebenssicherheit sowie Komfort- und Automatisierungslösungen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt 5.000 Spezialisten.

Wir bauen lokale Teams auf, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass lokale Experten die Besonderheiten ihres Marktes am besten verstehen. Ajax Systems ist weltweit mit Vertriebsmitarbeitern vertreten, unter anderem in Norwegen, Schweden, Dänemark, Finnland, Italien, Spanien, Deutschland, Frankreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, den USA, Australien, Südafrika und weiteren Regionen. Das globale Business-Development-Team vereint Gleichgesinnte, die die ambitionierten Ziele von Ajax Systems teilen.

Die Kombination aus erstklassiger Software und leistungsstarker Hardware hat die Wahrnehmung von Sicherheitssystemen für Anwender und Branchenexperten nachhaltig verändert. Durch Anerkennungen auf den größten Fachmessen wie IFSEC, Expoprotection und Intersec sowie durch den Gewinn renommierter Auszeichnungen führender Branchenmedien wie dem PSI Magazine und GIT SECURITY zählt Ajax heute zu den meistausgezeichneten Sicherheitssystemen Europas.

Die Produktion von Ajax Systems umfasst vier Fabriken, davon zwei in der Ukraine, eine in der Türkei und eine in Vietnam. Gleichzeitig gewährleistet die ISO-14001-Zertifizierung des Unternehmens eine minimale Umweltbelastung durch die Produktion. Die Auswahl der Komponenten für die Herstellung der Ajax-Geräte basiert auf Herstellererklärungen, die die Einhaltung der RoHS-Richtlinien bestätigen.

Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und arbeiten Sie an Europas Sicherheitssystem mit den meisten Auszeichnungen mit!

Voraussetzungen und Anforderungen an einen Regional Business Development Manager:

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich elektronischer Sicherheitssysteme (z. B. Intrusion, Video, Zutritt, Brand)
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder in der Unternehmensentwicklung in einem vertikalen B2B-Markt.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau (in Wort und Schrift).
  • Ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung für die eigenen Ergebnisse.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick: starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowohl am Telefon als auch im persönlichen Gespräch.
  • Hoch motiviert mit der Fähigkeit, Dinge zu verwirklichen.
  • Professionelles Auftreten, zuverlässiges und ethisches Verhalten.

Der Business Development Manager von Ajax Systems soll daher als Botschafter des Unternehmens und der Marke fungieren und die folgenden Aufgaben erfüllen:

  • Werbung für die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Ajax Systems bei Systemintegratoren, Errichtern, Fachberatern und Endverbrauchern (Geschäftspartnern) in Deutschland.
  • Erkundung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Organisation von Treffen mit Geschäftspartnern.
  • Planung und Vorbereitung von Präsentationen für Geschäftspartner und andere interessierte Personengruppen.
  • Aufbau und Erhaltung von Beziehungen zu Kooperationspartnern und Leitstellen.
  • Kommunikation von Produktfunktionen, Vorteilen und Entwicklungen an Geschäftspartner.
  • Durchführung von Produkt- und Handelsschulungen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Geschäftspartnern.
  • Aktive Förderung der Spezifikation von Systemen, die Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems enthalten.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebspartnern von Markenprodukten, um die Anforderungen der Geschäftspartner zu erfüllen.
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Marktstrategien für Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems.
  • Rückmeldung an das Management über die Anforderungen an aktuelle und zukünftige Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems.
  • Erstellen von genauen und zeitnahen Berichten unter Verwendung des CRM-Systems des Unternehmens zur Unterstützung der eigenen Aufgaben oder entsprechend den Anforderungen des Managements.

Wir bieten:

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Löhne - und ein transparentes Motivationssystem;
  • Ein Produkt, das sich selbst verkauft;
  • Bezahlung von Schulungen und Konferenzen, die wir für unsere Mitarbeiter durchführen;
  • Ein starkes, gut eingespieltes Team von Fachleuten;
  • Firmenwagen und alle Geschäftskosten abgedeckt.

Compensation

Additional Information

Wir arbeiten dafür, dass das Leben der Menschen friedlich und die Welt sicher ist. Werden Sie Teil des Teams, das ein intelligentes und sinnvolles globales Produkt herstellt.

About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Sr. Principal Sales Training Manager

Location: United States (Remote)

Experience: Senior

Job Function: Business Transformation

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: Computer & Network Security

About the position

The Senior Principal Sales Training Manager drives hands-on training, execution, and adoption of Keyfactor's global sales enablement programs. This role works directly with sellers and sales leaders to ensure the skills, methodologies, messaging, and tools introduced through enablement are consistently applied in the field.

A significant portion of this role focuses on delivering consistent, high-impact onboarding experience, guiding new sellers from initial training and certification through field readiness and productivity. This role also supports ongoing everboarding through live customer call observation, Gong reviews, and targeted coaching to reinforce skills and drive consistent field execution.

The Senior Principal Sales Training Manager plays a critical role in reinforcing Keyfactor’s Value Selling and MEDDICC methodologies, helping sellers improve discovery, qualification, business value conversations, multi-threading, executive engagement, and overall opportunity execution.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Job Responsibilities

Onboarding & Ramp Support

  • Execute established onboarding programs for new sales hires and ensure consistent delivery across cohorts.
  • Facilitate live training, workshops, role-playing, certifications, and practice sessions.
  • Track new-hire progress against established onboarding and ramp milestones.
  • Observe new hires in live selling situations and through Gong to evaluate field readiness and identify coaching needs.
  • Provide targeted reinforcement to help new sellers close knowledge or skill gaps and accelerate their path to productivity.
  • Communicate progress, risks, and coaching needs to Enablement and Sales Leadership.

Value Selling & MEDDICC Execution

  • Reinforce consistent application of Value Selling and MEDDICC throughout the sales cycle, including discovery, qualification, multi-threading, champion development, and executive engagement.
  • Coach sellers to connect technical challenges to business initiatives, desired outcomes, measurable impact, and executive priorities, strengthening why change, why now, and cost-of-status-quo conversations.
  • Evaluate seller execution of MEDDICC within active opportunities and provide targeted coaching to strengthen business cases, customer conversations, and deal execution.
  • Reinforce Keyfactor’s established messaging, sales plays, competitive positioning, and value propositions, helping sellers communicate effectively with both technical and executive audiences.
  • Identify recurring gaps in sales skills, methodology, messaging, and technical-to-business translation and share insights with Enablement and Sales Leadership to drive targeted reinforcement.

Field Coaching & Insights

  • Observe seller execution through live customer calls, Gong recordings, and field engagement, providing timely, actionable coaching to individuals and teams.
  • Track seller competency and adoption of enablement programs, messaging, and sales methodologies using Gong, CRM data, enablement platforms, and direct observation.
  • Reinforce skills introduced through onboarding and ongoing enablement through continuous coaching, practice, feedback, and field application.
  • Identify recurring skill gaps, coaching needs, and field trends, providing actionable insights to Enablement, Sales Leadership, and frontline managers.
  • Surface and share best practices and examples of strong execution, while measuring how enablement and coaching translate into improved seller performance.

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in B2B enterprise software, cybersecurity, sales, or sales enablement, with significant experience coaching enterprise sellers.
  • Field Coaching: Demonstrated ability to observe live sales interactions, diagnose skill gaps, and provide specific, actionable coaching.
  • Methodology Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Value Selling and MEDDICC, with experience reinforcing methodology in active enterprise opportunities.
  • Enterprise Sales Expertise: Strong understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and the behaviors required to successfully navigate them.
  • Technical-to-Business Fluency: Ability to understand complex technical concepts and coach sellers on translating them into clear customer outcomes and business value.
  • Facilitation: Strong facilitator comfortable leading onboarding sessions, workshops, role-playing exercises, certifications, and reinforcement sessions.
  • Analytical Mindset: Ability to use Gong, CRM, enablement data, and direct observation to identify trends and measure seller progress.
  • Coaching & Communication: Ability to build credibility with experienced sellers and sales leaders while delivering candid, actionable feedback.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Engineering, Product Marketing, Product, Revenue Operations, and the broader Enablement team.
  • Technology Fluency: Experience working with CRM, conversation intelligence, LMS/enablement platforms, and AI-powered sales tools.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 40% travel required.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities. 

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION: Applicants with disabilities may contact a member of Keyfactor’s People team via people@keyfactor.com and/or telephone at 1.216.785.2990 to request and arrange for accommodations at any time.

EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP.

Role Description

This is a forward-deployed engineering role. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes- the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments- and lead the software integration of modular Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) sensors and effectors. You will deploy, harden, integrate, and operate our modular C-UAS solution.

Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero, not always on a plane. Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement genuinely calls for it — initial standup, in-SCIF integration work, on-the-ground incident response, training, and knowledge transfer- and you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero the rest of the time. The job is being their engineer, not living at their desk.

You are a cross-functional engineering leader. You can take responsibility for the full breadth of a data and software integration platform- make it work where it has to work, analyze what's running through it, and solve problems in real time for the mission hero. About 20% of your time, you'll also help make Defense Unicorns' forward-deployed team better — pairing with junior Data Engineer FDEs on hard problems, helping them develop technical judgment, and raising the ceiling on what the team can take on.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and harden UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment — stand up UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required.

  • Own integration with existing mission systems — connect UDS Data Capability to existing infrastructure, including sensor arrays, computer-vision-enabled UAS interceptors, and a broad range of C-UAS solutions.

  • Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries — ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions.

  • Operate what you deploy — own initial day-2 operations, including capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Transition ownership to the mission hero's operations team once stable.

  • Generate accreditation artifacts — STIG evidence, cATO documentation, FIPS validation notes, and policy mappings to support ISSM/ISSO requirements in IL4/IL5 environments.

  • Represent the mission hero to product and engineering — document issues, write postmortems, recommend operator improvements, and communicate field challenges to the platform engineering team.

  • Train and transfer knowledge — develop runbooks, architecture documentation, working sessions, and knowledge-transfer materials that enable mission teams to operate independently.

  • Mentor junior Data Engineer FDEs — pair on complex problems, review integration designs, and help engineers develop technical judgment without direct people-management responsibilities.

Clearance & Travel

  • Clearance: Active TS/SCI required.

  • Travel: Approximately 10%–25%, based on mission and customer requirements.

  • On-site expectations: Ability to work in SCIFs and other restricted environments for days or weeks when required for integration, incident response, training, or knowledge transfer. Most work is performed remotely.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience working in tactical edge and interoperable mission environments, including TAK Server administration, ATAK/WinTAK, tactical communications, and disconnected or air-gapped systems.
  • Production experience with modern data platforms, including lakehouse technologies (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi), object storage (Ceph or S3-compatible), PostgreSQL, and analytical query engines such as Trino, DuckDB, ClickHouse, or Spark SQL.

We are seeking a CMMC Compliance Lead to join Commercial Cyber Operations. This person is the customer-facing lead for CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 engagements and owns NIST SP 800-171 interpretation, scoping, documentation, and assessment readiness from kickoff through the C3PAO assessment and into sustainment. Compliance Lead decides what the systems must satisfy, can configure the controls personally in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 GCC High, writes the record that proves it, and verifies the result the way an assessor would.

This is not a coordination role. The Compliance Lead scopes the assessment boundary, authors the System Security Plan and supporting documentation, directs and where needed performs control implementation, assesses the finished environment against the CMMC Level 2 Assessment Guide, and stands next to the customer during the assessment. They are the day-to-day point of contact for their assigned customers and answer CMMC questions with authority and in plain terms. Customer environments vary: Windows and macOS fleets, GCC High and Google Workspace tenants, Jamf and Intune, cloud and on-prem enclaves. This person has to be versatile enough to work in all of them.

Responsibilities

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers for the life of the engagement: run kickoff, working sessions, and status reporting; answer CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 questions directly and accurately without escalation.
  • Scope the CMMC assessment boundary: trace FCI and CUI flows, categorize assets per the CMMC Level 2 Scoping Guide (CUI, Security Protection, Contractor Risk Managed, Specialized, Out of Scope), and produce the boundary, data-flow, and network diagrams.
  • Lead each engagement through the standard delivery process from intake to assessor-ready package, holding the stage gates and evidence standards.

Decide which requirement each setting satisfies and why, and split the heavier build work with the Technical Implementation Engineer.

  • Working knowledge of networking and perimeter controls (firewalls, VPN and secure remote access, segmentation, DNS, wireless), enough to scope the boundary and verify the SC practices.

Location: These are EMEA-based remote roles.

  • Lead enablement programs to drive continuous improvement in sales productivity and ramp time

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team

Customer & Product Support (C&PS) sits at the intersection of sales, customer success and R&D teams. Through close teamwork and collaboration, we drive positive customer outcomes and ensure seamless access and optimal utilization of AlphaSense’s market-leading platform and products. We are committed to enhancing every user’s experience through consistent delivery of prompt and knowledgeable responses. The Customer & Product Support team is based globally across the US, Canada, UK, India and Singapore.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive Cloud Support Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will own technical problems end-to-end within your scope including investigating, diagnosing and resolving customer issues across SaaS and private cloud environments. In your role day-to-day, you will collaborate closely with senior engineers and technical customer contacts on more complex cases.

You will be the second line of defense for technical queries, working at the intersection of customers, frontline support and Engineering. This is a strong foundation role for someone early in their cloud support career with some experience, who has demonstrated relevant technical skills, contributing to a high-trust team and the ability to apply AI tools to scale their impact.

Growth paths from this role include progression with the Support function to Senior Cloud Support Engineer and beyond, or a move into our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, supported by structured training and collaboration with Engineering.

Who You Are

  • A technically curious engineer with 2 - 4 years in technical support, IT operations, cloud operations or a related field.
  • A clear communicator in writing and on customer calls, with the ability to explain technical concepts with appropriate clarity.
  • A problem-solver with a proactive, customer-first mindset and an eye for surfacing risks early.
  • Adaptable, eager to continuously learn, and willing to ask for help when blocked.
  • Energized by being part of an entrepreneurial team and willing to pull your own weight to help the team succeed.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver exceptional technical support: Act as the second line of defense for technical queries, ensuring timely and effective resolution of customer issues through close collaboration between L1 support and R&D teams. Own the customer-facing loop on your assigned tickets, driving them to resolution with urgency.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges: Diagnose issues using logs, traces, and reproducible test cases; work confidently with kubectl, awscli, and at least one scripting language. Resolve in-scope issues completely and escalate out-of-scope issues to the correct engineering domain with high-quality artifacts.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner effectively within the team and across regions and time zones; share knowledge proactively and close loops on commitments. Build working relationships with both account teams and R&D as you grow your technical credibility.
  • Documentation: Contribute to runbooks, KEDB articles, and FAQs. Maintain documentation hygiene on the issues you own.
  • Be an advocate for customers: Represent the voice of the customer in internal discussions and initiatives to maximize the value of our platform and products.
  • Build working knowledge of the AlphaSense platform and core products. Identify your own knowledge gaps and build a plan to close them.
  • Use AI tools in your daily work for technical investigations, log analysis, customer communication and documentation. Build repeatable prompts and workflows rather than one-off use; share what works with the team.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 2 - 4 years in technical support, IT operations, cloud operations or a related field.
  • Working proficiency with CLI tools (e.g., kubectl, awscli) and scripting skills in Python, JavaScript or similar.
  • Working knowledge of GraphQL, REST APIs and MCP-related troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with connecting LLMs to external tools, including multi-agent systems.
  • Exposure to alerting and logging systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, FireHydrant).
  • Demonstrated AI fluency in day-to-day work: can speak to examples of how AI has changed the way they work.
  • Experience managing customer support cases through their lifecycle from inquiry, triage, bug reporting, through to resolution.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers and team members.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in networking and troubleshooting complex network issues
  • Experience troubleshooting in at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and containerized environments using Kubernetes or Docker.

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph

This is a remote position based in Ireland.

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success.

As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph, you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best.

Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences.

You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user
  • Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity
  • Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives
  • Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team
  • Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations
  • Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements
  • Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users
  • A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them
  • Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind
  • Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space
  • Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity
  • Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain
  • Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring
  • Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact

When you apply, please:

  • Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective.

An overview of this role

You'll build and lead the regional team of product Subject Matter Experts who win GitLab's most complex opportunities. Your team covers four product groups: Security & Compliance, Platform, Core DevSecOps, and AI & Competitive. You'll partner with regional sales leadership to decide where SMEs go, coach your team to technical wins, and make sure every engagement leaves the Account team stronger. This is a player-coach role. You'll stay close to the technology and step into critical deals yourself.

What you'll do

  • Hire, develop and retain a regional team of SMEs across four product groups, with a clear growth path for each person.
  • Run the regional engagement model with Account SA and Post-Sales leaders. Keep triage fast, coverage focused on the top opportunities, and the line between Account SA and SME ownership clear.
  • Partner with regional sales leaders and AVPs on deal strategy, forecast calls and product-category plans.
  • Review SME coverage weekly against the regional pipeline. Move capacity to where product-category commit and consumption are at risk.
  • Step into strategic deals as an executive technical sponsor when the opportunity calls for it.
  • Coach SMEs on PoV design, executive storytelling and competitive positioning. Hold a high bar for technical quality.
  • Keep engagement and outcome data accurate in Salesforce so the team's impact is visible and measurable.
  • Work with your peer regional managers and the Senior Director on shared assets, enablement programs and a consistent global playbook.
  • Bring regional customer and competitive signals to Product and Engineering through the Senior Director.
  • Build a team culture of trust, ownership and learning. Celebrate wins openly and treat misses as data.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ Years experience leading technical pre-sales, solutions architecture or consulting, including time leading teams of technical individual contributors.
  • Hands-on depth in at least one of the four product groups, and enough breadth to coach across all four, including working fluency with AI-assisted development.
  • A record of hiring and developing high-performing technical specialists or SAs.
  • Experience partnering with sales leaders on enterprise forecasts, deal strategy and territory planning.
  • Comfort with data. You can show how your team moves win rates, cycle times and consumption.
  • Strong executive presence with customers and internal leaders.
  • Experience leading through change, with clear and steady communication.
  • Experience running an overlay or specialist team, or launching a new team or product category.
  • Ability to travel at least 25%

  • Regional product-category commit attainment and consumption growth.
  • Technical win rate, PoV conversion and time to production use on SME-engaged opportunities.
  • SME coverage of the top 10% of regional opportunities, and lead time from request to engagement.
  • Account SA satisfaction with SME support.
  • Team hiring, ramp time, engagement and retention.
